---
title: "PROC UNIVARIATE"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r setup}
library(sasonr)
```

PROC UNIVARIATE describes the distribution of numeric variables: moments,
basic measures of location and variability, tests for location, quantiles and
extreme observations.

```{r}
res <- sas_run("
options nocenter;
data vitals;
  input sbp @@;
  datalines;
128 124 135 131 118 121 140 126 133 119
;
run;
proc univariate data=vitals;
  var sbp;
run;
")
cat(res$listing, sep = "\n")
```
